rounds.oldMeaning: Umuntu ofundisako nanyana oqondisako ekufundeni. Bekungakabi ligama lesonto kuphela.
rounds.story: Ngesikhathi sabathunywa bekolo, igama elalitjho ofundisako lagxila kakhulu emholini wesonto.

rounds.oldMeaning: Uthango lwameva namaplanka oluvikela umuzi nanyana isibaya.
rounds.story: Kwathi sekusetjenziswa iintambo zemilayezo, ucingo lathoma ukubizwa nazo. Ekugcineni labe litjho ifoni.

rounds.oldMeaning: Isiqubuthu sabantu esihlangene ukweluleka, ukukhuluma nanyana ukwenza umhlangano.
rounds.story: Ukufika kobuKrestu kwenza ibandla lagxila kakhulu esiqubuthwini sabakhulekeli besonto.

rounds.oldMeaning: Iinsiba zenyoni. Zasetjenziswa khulu ekwenzeni amathulusi wokubhala.
rounds.story: Ngebanga lokuthi iinsiba bezibhalisa, igama lasuka esibeni senyoni layokutjho ipeni.

rounds.oldMeaning: Imoto eqatjhelwako yokuthwala umuntu munye nanyana abambalwa lapho bafuna ukuya khona.
rounds.story: ESewula Afrika iteksi lagcina litjho khulu ikombi ethwala abantu emizileni ejayelekileko.

rounds.oldMeaning: Umtjhina owenza umsebenzi njengomuntu, khulukhulu efektharini nanyana emsebenzini onzima.
rounds.story: Ekukhulumeni kwelapha, irobhothi laqalisa ukubizwa isibane esilawula ukuhamba kweemoto.

rounds.oldMeaning: Into ethatjwa esihlahleni sengwe enwebekako begodu eguqukako.
rounds.story: Ezikolweni irabha yasetjenziswa ukusula okubhaliweko. Kancane kancane abantu bathi irabha batjho isulisamapensela.

rounds.oldMeaning: Isitulo eside nanyana ibhenji lokuhlala abantu abaningana.
rounds.story: Ngebanga lokuhwebelana, igama elake latjho ibhenji lagcina selitjho indawo yokugcina nokubolekisa imali.
Ngokuthuthuka kobutjhinatjhina, ikhamera lasuka ekutjho igumbi layokutjho umtjhina weenthombe.

rounds.oldMeaning: Ukusakaza ilizwi nanyana iindaba ebantwini abanengi.
rounds.story: Igama lesenzo lagcina lisetjenziswa emtjhinini owamukela nanyana osakaza iindaba nomculo.

rounds.oldMeaning: Umuntu othwala umlayezo nanyana oya kubikela abanye iindaba.
rounds.story: Kuthe ngephephandaba nomsakazo, intathelizindaba lagxila kakhulu emuntwini osebenza njengejornali.

rounds.oldMeaning: Indawo lapho iindlela ezimbili ziphambana khona nanyana ukuwela komugqa nomunye.
rounds.story: Ngokwanda kobuKrestu, isiphambano saqalisa ukwaziwa khulu njengephawu lenkolo.
